title: Effective Interact upstream local selective merge
summary: Compared upstream Harness Hub effective-interact with the local AI daily adapted implementation, rejected unsafe wholesale overwrite and hover sibling dim behavior, then codified a selective aggregation policy with fixture and unit coverage proving upstream component style and local production renderer extensions can coexist.

validation_commands: red aggregation check failed before implementation with missing aggregation policy and missing no-hover-dim rule
green aggregation check passed after documentation and fixture updates
node --test --test-name-pattern "effective-interact preserves local production extensions" tests/skills.test.js
playwright screenshot check for desktop and mobile local artifact

lessons.lesson: Upstream effective-interact should be treated as a style and component reference in this repository, not as an implementation source that can overwrite local production renderer extensions.
lessons.evidence: The upstream active files were narrower than the local adapted files and would remove local title links, media lightbox, tracking components, hero extensions, and official snapshot containment if copied wholesale.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep the Upstream/Local Aggregation Policy in DESIGN.md and require focused tests before accepting future upstream effective-interact implementation changes.

lessons.lesson: Hover sibling dim and blur patterns are not compatible with the public daily reader contract.
lessons.evidence: The upstream CSS introduced a hover sibling dim pattern, while the local ledger and unit tests require no hover dim/blur of public daily card text.
lessons.recommended_action: Prefer active-item lift, outline, shadow, or spotlight while keeping sibling evidence readable.

suggestions.issue: The Harness Hub updater and aggregation manifest still lack an explicit target-adapted skill mode for effective-interact.
suggestions.evidence: This task had to reconcile upstream and local effective-interact manually even though the previous manifest described full-overwrite sync.
suggestions.suggestion: Add per-skill aggregation modes such as style-reference or target-adapted so future effective-interact updates can import docs, fixtures, and safe primitives without replacing production renderer behavior.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future Harness Hub updates can absorb upstream design work with less risk of breaking AI daily report rendering tests.
suggestions.promotion_path: Future project_iteration after user confirmation; requires updater tests and manifest contract update.

followups.action: Model effective-interact as a target-adapted skill in the Harness Hub aggregation manifest or updater.
